title: termal_review_identity refuses a malformed request with a bare invalid_request that names no field
outcome: A refused termal_review_identity request says which field or combination was wrong, so the caller can correct it without reading source.
acceptance: Each invalid_request refusal from termal_review_identity names the offending field or forbidden combination, such as platformProfile on capture, in its returned reason.
Valid requests and the existing refusal codes are unchanged, shown by a behaviour test per refusal case.
